args.subject: Group Booking Availability – 10 Guests in June 2024
args.body:
Dear City Hub Tokyo Group Bookings Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I found your address through a guest review on your hotel's listing and am writing to enquire about availability for a group stay.

We are organising a group stay for 10 people in June 2024 and would love to find out whether you have room available for a group of that size. Could you please let me know:

- Whether you can accommodate 10 guests for a group booking in June 2024
- The dates for which group availability is possible
- Any group rates, minimum stay requirements, or booking deadlines
- Whether you offer group amenities such as breakfast, meeting space, or airport transfers

If you need further details such as preferred dates, room type requirements, or a rough budget, please don't hesitate to let me know and I will be happy to provide them.

Thank you for your time, and I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
327-420-4923
